rationale: The v4 design implements the working diagnosis's highest-value structural route: it replaces a broad integrated claims exchange with a partner-delivered, fixed-scope audit for one retailer and one deduction class, using customer-created exports and an explicit eligibility gate, while deferring persistent connectors and recurring software until measured incremental value, delivery effort, permissions, repeat demand, and contribution margin exist. This changes the paid event, channel, control point, service boundary, and planning capital from PLN 45,000 to a hypothetical PLN 18,000 envelope while retaining incumbent overlap and all material demand, data-rights, attribution, margin, and founder-conflict uncertainties.
